notes: run_surface_batch and surface_fill take a cohort (id or name, any cohort in the lattice including screen-derived). Membership is resolved AT BATCH TIME — and for a fill, RE-RESOLVED ON EVERY TICK — so a rules-based cohort prices what its rule matches now: names entering the rule join the queue mid-fill, names leaving stop being ticked. The scope restricts the queue; staleness, ranking and the budget apply unchanged (a scoped refresh, not a forced one — symbols remains the forced audit path and wins where both are given).
